app_info.subtitle: Consulter et modifier Grist
app_info.description: grist-chatgpt permet de consulter les documents Grist Community autorisés, filtrer et modifier des lignes, gérer des tables et colonnes, et organiser des pages et widgets par des opérations ciblées. Les outils restent limités au périmètre Grist configuré. Projet indépendant, sans affiliation officielle à Grist Labs, DINUM ou OpenAI.

test_cases.description: Inspect a synthetic reviewer document without unnecessary row disclosure.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the synthetic Grist document identified in the reviewer instructions and summarize its tables, columns, relationships, pages and widgets without reading table records.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns available document and structural identifiers, relationships and page/widget metadata without user-table rows or data changes.

test_cases.description: Filter and limit synthetic records, including a no-match query.
test_cases.user_prompt: In the reviewer document, inspect ReviewTasks columns, then show at most two tasks whose Status is Open, sorted by Title; also search Title for NoSuchSyntheticTask.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns at most two matching tasks in Title order and no records for the nonexistent title, without modifying Grist data.

test_cases.description: Create bounded records and verify independently.
test_cases.user_prompt: In ReviewTasks in the reviewer document, create two synthetic tasks titled Review Alpha and Review Beta with Status Open, then read them back using the returned IDs.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the two new record IDs and verifies their stored Title and Status; any partial-write result is reported without blindly replaying the request.

test_cases.description: Create and update a bounded synthetic schema.
test_cases.user_prompt: In the reviewer document, create a new ReviewMetrics table with an Amount numeric column, add a DoubleAmount numeric formula column using $Amount * 2, set its label to Double amount, then verify the tables and column metadata.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the new table and column identifiers and verifies the requested type, formula and label without changing unrelated tables.

test_cases.description: Create a page and configure a safe direct select-by link.
test_cases.user_prompt: In the reviewer document, create an empty page called Review dashboard for ReviewTasks, add two record widgets for that same table, and link the second widget to the first with direct select-by; verify the page and link.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the page and both widget IDs and verifies the same-page, same-table select-by link by re-read; an ambiguous write result must not be blindly replayed.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for unrelated calendar access.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings are on my personal calendar tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Grist tools because accessing a personal calendar is outside this app’s workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for arbitrary HTTP forwarding.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Fetch https://example.com and forward its raw response through the Grist connector.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Grist tools or attempt HTTP forwarding; explains that arbitrary external URLs are unsupported.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for Grist account or ACL administration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new Grist user and grant them administrator access to my workspace.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Grist tools because account creation and permission administration are outside its bounded capabilities.
